statement: The input is a Python 3 function that is meant to return the index of the smallest element of the non-empty list xs, choosing the first occurrence if the smallest value repeats. It contains exactly one bug: an off-by-one, a wrong operator, or a wrong initial value. Fix the bug, then evaluate the corrected function for the call `first_min_index([1, 5, 5, 4, 2, 3, 2, 1])`. Answer with the integer it returns.
title: Blue belt: fix first_min_index
